sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a hall inside a giant pale sphere half sunk in the earth, curved white walls rising into a dome. A great white stone sphere rolls in a groove across the floor past three footprints carved in the stone, a two-toed print, a three-toed print and a four-toed print; it has come to rest on the three-toed one. By the east wall three more prints of two, three and four toes, and a cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack stands on the three-toed print there, dwarfed by the hall; over the far door a carved three-toed print, and the door sinking open. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, white sphere stone, pale blue, peach light, lavender shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
